title: Fei Fei flies to the moon.
lines: In a little village in China, between the rivers and the rice fields, lives a girl.
Her name is Fei Fei.
She is clever and she loves science.
She does experiments and she builds things.
Her family has a bakery.
They bake mooncakes.
Those are small round cakes with a sweet filling.
You eat them at the Moon Festival, when the moon is completely round.
When Fei Fei was little, her mum told her a story every evening.
The story of Chang'e, the goddess of the moon.
Long ago, said Mum, Chang'e and Houyi were very much in love.
But Chang'e drank a magic potion and she floated up to the moon.
Houyi stayed behind on the earth.
Chang'e now lives on the moon, with her rabbit.
She is still waiting for her love.
Fei Fei loved that story.
But her mum became ill.
And one day she was gone.
Fei Fei misses her mum very much.
Now, a few years later, Dad has a new girlfriend.
Her name is Mrs Zhong.
She has a little boy, Chin.
Chin is very wild.
He jumps around like a frog and plays with his rabbit.
Fei Fei doesn't want a new mum.
She wants her own mum.
At the Moon Festival Fei Fei says: I'm going to the moon!
I'm going to prove that Chang'e is real.
Everyone laughs.
But Fei Fei is clever.
She builds a rocket.
She calculates and she draws.
She uses a bicycle, magnets and lots of fireworks.
And one night, when the moon is round, she takes off.
Whoosh!
With her rabbit Bungee by her side.
But she isn't alone.
Chin is secretly sitting in the back of the rocket!
Fei Fei is cross.
But it's too late.
They're already flying.
Higher and higher.
The rocket shakes.
But then something grabs the rocket.
Two big golden lions pull them up to the moon.
The moon isn't grey and quiet.
It's full of colours and lights.
There are houses made of light, glowing creatures and clouds like candy floss.
It's a magical city.
Lunaria!
And there she is.
Chang'e, the goddess of the moon.
She is beautiful.
She has long black hair and she sings like a pop star.
Fei Fei can't believe it.
She's real!
But Chang'e is sad.
She has been waiting so long for her love Houyi.
She wants a gift back, a glowing piece of her magic crystal.
Whoever finds it gets what they wish for.
Fei Fei goes to look for it.
Together with Chin, who isn't as annoying as she thought after all.
And with a funny little green creature called Gobi.
They find the gift.
But Fei Fei understands something.
Chang'e has been waiting so long for someone who will never come back.
She has stood still.
She doesn't dare to move on.
And Fei Fei does the same.
She doesn't want anything to change.
Because she misses her mum so much.
Chang'e and Fei Fei talk.
They cry together.
And Chang'e says something Fei Fei will never forget.
Your mum isn't gone.
She lives in your heart.
And your heart is big enough to love new people too.
Fei Fei looks at Chin.
Chin looks at her, with his funny eyes.
He's actually quite sweet.
Fei Fei smiles.
They fly back to the earth.
Dad and Mrs Zhong are waiting for them.
They have been so worried.
Fei Fei hugs Dad.
And then she hugs Mrs Zhong.
That evening they eat mooncakes together.
With the whole family.
With Chin too.
Fei Fei looks at the round moon.
She waves.
Goodbye Chang'e, she whispers.
Goodbye Mum.
The end.
